title.value: NL-PS-L1-A - Level 1a: Minimal metadata and empty sections

description.value: The serving system provides an NL-PS for its level 1a test patient (NL-Patient-L1b in the test plan), in which all mandatory sections are empty, with an emptyReason and a narrative. Conformancelab sends the bearer token you enter at test setup to your server. Use a token issued by your own system that gives access to your level 1a test patient, and only to that patient. Without a token the server may return the Patient Summaries of several patients; the script then tests the first one. Implementation Guides: NL-PS https://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/ and generic building blocks (GBB) https://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/
